title: Solving with the order still intact

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Raise both pans by the same amount. The rail does not turn over.
With 6 lifted off both, the mark is sitting at 7.

worldFraming.text: Raise both pans by the same amount and the admitted stretch slides along the rail without turning over.

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
A cold value on the rail is not the same as turning the rail over.
Only a count can turn the detent, and the count here is one. The mark lands at 14.

worldFraming.text: The Nearlies raise this one whenever the fishing is bad.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.

Line 2 is where the load stops matching.
